title: DVB-T2 BCH+LDPC concatenation codec
description:
## Goal

Provide a single concatenated DVB-T2 codec API that wraps the existing
BCH outer code and LDPC inner code into one encode / decode call,
matching the ETSI EN 302 755 v1.4.1 §6 chain ordering exactly. This is
the integration point the campaign runner targets; without it, every
caller would have to hand-stitch BCH ⇄ LDPC and risk spec-divergent
ordering.

## Context

Today the BCH (`crates/gf2-coding/src/bch/dvb_t2/`) and LDPC
(`crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/`) codecs are constructed
independently. The TP04 → TP05 → TP06 chain is verified for one
configuration (VV001-CR35) but only via manual stitching in tests.

Per ETSI EN 302 755 v1.4.1 §6.1 and Table 6a (Normal frame) /
Table 7a (Short frame), the encode order is:

```
BBFRAME (k_bch bits) → BCH encode → +192 parity bits
                    → LDPC encode → +(N − k_ldpc) parity bits
                    → FECFRAME (N bits, ready for bit interleaver)
```

The decode order on the receive side is LDPC belief propagation first
(soft input), then BCH hard-decision error correction on the
information field.

This task wraps that ordering and the per-config k values behind a
single API.

## Deliverables

1. New module: `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/concat.rs` (or
   similarly named; placement under `ldpc/dvb_t2/` keeps the
   spec-aware glue colocated with the inner code).
2. Public type, e.g. `DvbT2Concat`, with at minimum:
   - `pub fn new(frame_size: FrameSize, code_rate: CodeRate)
        -> Result<Self, Error>`
   - `pub fn encode(&self, bbframe: &BitVec) -> BitVec`
   - `pub fn decode_soft(&self, llrs: &[Llr])
        -> Result<BitVec, DecodeError>`
3. Constructor mirrors the existing `BchCode::dvb_t2` /
   `LdpcCode::dvb_t2` constructors so callers can swap individual
   codecs for the concatenated one.
4. Roundtrip unit tests for the 3 in-scope configurations
   (Normal × {1/2, 2/3, 3/4}) with random payloads and zero noise.
5. End-to-end TP04 → TP06 vector test for at least one configuration,
   re-using the existing verified vector loader.

## Success criteria

- [hard] All 3 in-scope (Normal × {1/2, 2/3, 3/4}) configurations
  round-trip random payloads bit-exact at zero noise.
- [hard] Existing TP04 → TP06 verified vector continues to pass through
  the new concatenated API (no regression in the legacy hand-stitched
  test).
- [hard] No new `unsafe`; new module satisfies
  `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] Encoded length matches EN 302 755 Table 6a for each of the
  3 covered configurations (asserted in tests).
- [hard] Public API has rustdoc with the standard sections
  (description, arguments, examples that compile under
  `cargo test --doc`, panics, complexity).

## Non-goals

- The 9 out-of-scope LDPC configurations (Short × all rates,
  Normal × {3/5, 4/5, 5/6}) may either return `Err(Unsupported)` from
  `new` or be wired without test coverage; the campaign only
  exercises the 3.
- No QAM mapping — that lives in NEW-2 (campaign runner).
- No bit interleaver — that is 87a2402f.
- No decoder algorithm changes — uses the existing belief-propagation
  LDPC decoder and the existing BCH decoder.
